pqc_capability_description: BERTEN MLKE-B135 is a FIPS 203-compliant ML-KEM (Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism, derived from CRYSTALS-Kyber) IP core for FPGA, SoC, and ASIC implementation, portable to AMD (Xilinx), Intel (Altera), and Microchip (Microsemi) device families. Countermeasures include resistance to timing and Simple Power Analysis (SPA) side-channel attacks, FIPS 203 input validation, and automatic/on-demand zeroization of internal memories and registers. Deliverables under a perpetual site license (12 months support) include an encrypted netlist, design constraints, simulation model, user manual, and ANSI C drivers.
